apps.name: WoW Reader
apps.shortDescription: A private, elegant EPUB & PDF reader built for comfortable Myanmar and English reading.
apps.description: WoW Reader brings your EPUB and PDF library into a clean, distraction-free reading space. Import books once, organize them by title or author, read in immersive full screen, tune typography, use your own Myanmar fonts, and keep highlights, notes and reading progress on your device.

features.title: EPUB & PDF library
features.text: Import books into an app-owned local library and keep reading even if the original download is removed.

features.title: Myanmar typography
features.text: Pyidaungsu and multiple built-in Myanmar fonts, plus custom font import and live display controls.

features.title: Immersive reading
features.text: Edge-to-edge full-screen reading with page or scroll mode, themes, margins, line height and brightness controls.

features.title: Notes & highlights
features.text: Highlight passages, save notes, bookmark pages and return to your saved reading positions.

features.title: Author shelves
features.text: Group books by EPUB author metadata and instantly filter the library to one writer.

features.title: Adaptive library
features.text: Responsive list/grid layouts scale from phones to tablets, foldables and landscape screens.

whatsNew: Added White, Black and Navy Premium app themes.
Made None and Slide page animations behave distinctly.
Smoothed chapter transitions and reduced visible loading/settling.
Imported books are kept as app-owned local copies until you remove them from the library.
Kept author grouping, responsive library layouts and reader display controls polished for daily use.

safety.title: Local-first by design
safety.text: No Google account is required in this release. Imported books and reader data remain on your device unless you explicitly export or back them up.

apps.name: WoW EPUB Maker
apps.shortDescription: Convert DOCX into a compact, beautifully structured EPUB entirely on your device.
apps.description: WoW EPUB Maker is an offline DOCX-to-EPUB builder designed for private, on-device conversion. Choose a Word document, set book details, preserve useful document structure and create an EPUB without uploading the source document to a server.

features.title: 100% offline
features.text: DOCX conversion is designed to run on the device without sending the document to an online conversion service.

features.title: DOCX to EPUB
features.text: Build a structured EPUB from Microsoft Word documents with title and author metadata.

features.title: Document preservation
features.text: Preserves useful page structure, footnotes, Word layout, chapters and fonts where appropriate.

features.title: Optimized images
features.text: Keeps image display size while optimizing assets for a smaller EPUB package.

features.title: Live build progress
features.text: Shows conversion stages and a live build log while the EPUB is being created.

features.title: Read after build
features.text: Open the newly created EPUB directly after a successful conversion.

whatsNew: Preview listing for WoW EPUB Maker v0.2.0.
Download is temporarily disabled while the release build is prepared.
APK will be published only when the release is ready.

safety.title: Offline and private
safety.text: The app is designed for local document conversion. The APK is intentionally not hosted in the App Store repository yet and downloads remain disabled until release.

apps.name: WoW OCR
apps.shortDescription: Scan documents, extract Myanmar text with OCR and AI OCR, edit it, and export on Android.
apps.description: WoW OCR is an Android-first scanning and OCR workspace built for Myanmar documents. Scan multiple pages, import photos or PDFs, clean and enhance page images, extract text with offline Myanmar OCR, hand pages to Google Lens when needed, use optional Cloud Vision or AI OCR providers, edit recognized text, and export your work as TXT, DOCX or PDF.

features.title: Multi-page scanner
features.text: Scan documents with Google ML Kit Document Scanner, automatic edge handling and a phone-friendly page workflow.

features.title: Photo & PDF import
features.text: Import one or many images from Gallery or Files, or import a PDF and render its pages into the document workspace.

features.title: Page cleanup tools
features.text: Crop, rotate, grayscale and enhance scanned pages before recognition or export.

features.title: Myanmar OCR
features.text: Use offline Myanmar OCR, with optional Google Cloud Vision for fast online document text detection.

features.title: AI OCR
features.text: Choose a supported AI provider and use your own API key when higher-quality OCR is needed.

features.title: Google Lens handoff
features.text: Open a page in Google Lens for interactive Lens-quality text selection, with share-sheet fallback where needed.

features.title: Text workspace
features.text: Paste, edit, copy, find and replace recognized text, then export as TXT or DOCX.

features.title: PDF export
features.text: Export all document pages as a PDF after organizing and cleaning the scan.

features.title: Page library
features.text: Search, rename, duplicate, reorder and delete pages inside a multi-page document.

features.title: Appearance themes
features.text: White, Black and Midnight appearance options are available from Settings.

whatsNew: WoW OCR v0.8.0 preview listing added.
Rich text and page-continuation export improvements are included in the current build line.
Branded splash screen and document editing workflow are represented in this preview.
Download remains disabled until the release APK is intentionally published.

safety.title: Coming Soon — no APK hosted
safety.text: The App Store currently hosts only the WoW OCR listing, icon and preview images. The APK path is empty and the download button stays disabled until you choose to publish a release file.

apps.name: WoW Proof Reader
apps.shortDescription: Read, proof, edit and finish book-production DOCX files on Android, then export a polished EPUB.
apps.description: WoW Proof Reader is a phone-first Android proofreading workspace for book production. Open formatted DOCX files, read them in an ebook-like view, correct text while reading, review edited places, preserve the original Word package, create backups, and finish the corrected book as a validated EPUB without relying on a cloud conversion service at runtime.

features.title: DOCX library
features.text: Use a multi-DOCX library with search, sorting, Grid/List views, favorites, archive, trash, progress and quick resume.

features.title: Reader-first proofreading
features.text: Read long DOCX books in an EPUB-like view with configurable typography, margins, themes, custom fonts and heading navigation.

features.title: Phone-friendly editing
features.text: Double-tap paragraphs to edit, use find/replace, undo/redo, proof marks, bookmarks and crash-safe local drafts.

features.title: Edited Places review
features.text: Compare original and edited paragraphs, review all changed locations and restore individual paragraphs when needed.

features.title: Formatting controls
features.text: Edit Bold, paragraph alignment, paragraph style, page breaks, first-line indents and supported picture dimensions.

features.title: DOCX preservation
features.text: Patch targeted OpenXML parts instead of rebuilding the whole document, preserve unchanged ZIP entries and create backups before overwriting.

features.title: Finish Proofing → EPUB
features.text: Build EPUB 2 output with metadata, chapters, page breaks, footnotes, image sizing, Myanmar fonts and strict XML/package validation.

features.title: Live EPUB build
features.text: Show visible DOCX PREP, EPUB BUILD, MEDIA OPTIMIZE, LAYOUT LINK and XML VERIFY stages until EPUB READY.

features.title: Built-in EPUB reader
features.text: Verify exported EPUB files with NCX/nav support, table of contents, internal footnotes, themes and last-chapter resume.

features.title: Local-first privacy
features.text: Core proofreading, EPUB generation, validation and reading are performed on-device with no account required for local books.
